title: Clonotrace
text: Understanding clonal structure dynamics central problem single-cell transcriptomics, particularly immune cancer biology. Modern single-cell technologies increasingly enable joint measurement transcriptomes clonal barcodes (e.g., TCR sequences genetic lineage tracers), providing opportunity study transcriptional states evolve clone level rather level individual cells. Clonotrace designed analyze clonal behavior single-cell data integrating transcriptomic embeddings clone information. Rather treating clones discrete labels, Clonotrace models clone distribution cells low-dimensional embedding space, enabling quantitative comparison clonal transcriptional states. vignette provides step--step tutorial demonstrating use Clonotrace : - Estimate clone-level density cell embedding - Compute clone--clone distances using optimal transport (OT) - Cluster clones transcriptional profiles - Perform downstream analyses profile-level pseudotime gene association
